notes: Blast physics: explosions throw smoke and dust outward, punch holes through rain, snow and fog, bend trees, kick up rubble, flip wrecks and throw soldiers
Big blasts in bad weather clear a pocket for a while: units inside it spot enemies at their full range until the weather rolls back in
Heavy fog now rolls across the ground as drifting mist
Leaderboard: new My rank tab with everyone in your current rank, next to the Overall top 100
Bots keep their word: a bot that says it will attack one of your bases sends its army there, and one that promises money sends it later
Bots trade words when one takes another's base, then really go after it
Calmer chat: bots answer you right away, but their own chatter is limited to a couple of lines at a time and never repeats
Weather: rain, thunderstorms with lightning and thunder, snowfall and heavy fog change during the match and cut how far units spot enemies
Fixed: your name could show as Someone on the leaderboard
